pages.text: Where each metal comes from in this pack, read from the mods' world generation data. Depths are Y levels, Overworld unless noted.$(br2)Ores go further when $(l:materials/ore_doubling)crushed$(/l). Drillable veins: $(l:industry/ore_excavation)Ore Excavation$(/l).

Coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond and emerald are vanilla. Terrain mods such as Tectonic change where they end up.$(br2)$(thing)Zinc$() comes from Create: Y -63 to 70. Brass is copper plus zinc.
pages.title: Vanilla and Create
Zinc Ore
pages.text: Overworld, Y -63 to 70, stone and deepslate. Northstar's planets have their own zinc ores, and both count as zinc ore in recipes.

$(li)$(item)Lead$(): Y -16 to 60$(li)$(item)Uranium$(): Y -63 to 16, sparse$(li)$(item)Thorium$(): Y -16 to 55$(li)$(item)Nitrate$(): Y -63 to 64$(br2)Autunite, a building stone, forms striated veins below Y 16.
pages.title: Create Nuclear
Lead Ore
pages.text: The pack's only generated lead, since TFMG's lead ore is off. Mining drops Raw Lead. The ore block itself has no crushing recipe; crush the raw lead.

pages.title: Uranium Ore
pages.text: Deep and rare. Feeds $(l:industry/nuclear)the reactor$(/l). Alex's Caves adds its own uranium in Toxic Caves.

$(li)$(item)Nickel$(): Y -63 to 20$(li)$(item)Lithium$(): Y -63 to -5, sparse$(li)$(item)Bauxite$(): a stone that crushes to powder, the start of aluminum$(li)Galena: decorative, not an ore$(li)Lead: off$(br)Oil: $(l:industry/tfmg_oil)Oil$(/l).
pages.title: TFMG
Nickel Ore
pages.text: Y -63 to 20. Nickel goes into TFMG alloys such as constantan. Lithium ore sits deeper, below Y -5.

Titanium and tungsten exist only off-world, in planet-specific blocks.$(li)Titanium: Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus$(li)Tungsten: Mercury only$(li)Zinc, copper, iron, gold, redstone, diamond: all four$(br)$(l:space/planets)Planets$(/l)
pages.title: Northstar planets
Titanium Ore
pages.text: Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus each have their own block. Drops raw titanium, which smelts to a titanium ingot.
$(li)Glowstone: Moon, Mercury, Venus$(li)Lapis: Moon, Mercury$(li)Nether quartz: Mars, Venus$(li)Coal: Venus$(br2)Mercury's tungsten ore is plentiful. It crushes to Crushed Raw Tungsten.
pages.title: More planet ores

pages.text: Other mods add Overworld metals:$(li)$(item)Platinum$() (Create Propulsion): Y -63 to about 16$(li)$(item)Mithril$() (Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks): Y -63 to -38, very deep
pages.title: Other Overworld ores
Platinum Ore
pages.text: Create Propulsion's metal. Crushes and washes like any Create ore. Deep Overworld.

pages.title: Mithril Ore
pages.text: Y -63 to -38. Crushing gives Crushed Mithril from Create: Wizardry, which can be washed or smelted.

$(li)$(item)Aether$(): zanite, gravitite, ambrosium and icestone in holystone$(li)$(item)Alex's Caves$(): galena iron in Magnetic Caves, uranium in Toxic Caves, coal and redstone in Forlorn Hollows$(li)$(item)Better End$(): thallasium, ender and amber ore
pages.title: Dimension ores
Zanite Ore
pages.text: Aether holystone. Zanite and ambrosium ores have Create crushing recipes, so a Crushing Wheel doubles them too.

No ore generation of their own:$(li)Alloyed: bronze and steel are alloys$(li)Create Crafts & Additions: electrum is an alloy$(li)Cataclysm: its metals are not mined$(br2)Twilight Forest grows Iron, Copper and Gold Oreberry bushes instead of veins.
pages.title: Not mined
